notes.title: Toggle Tool Enabled (Ver 1.0.2)
notes.content: - Added a new feature that allows you to enable or disable tools as needed.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.1)
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that prevented flesh from being grasped when using a monitor with a high refresh rate.

- Fixed a problem where the burning sound could not be heard when the game was started again after "save and exit".
